0022600031.text: The New Orleans Pelicans host the Minnesota Timberwolves in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup, with the Pelicans (4-4, 3-2 at home) on a four-game winning streak and sitting 11th in the West, 2.5 games back in the Southwest. Minnesota (6-3, 3-2 on the road) enters on a two-game winning streak, 0.5 games back in the Northwest and 7th in the West. New Orleans is missing Trey Murphy III (knee) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Pelicans lost 1-3 to the Timberwolves in 2025-26, including a 132-126 loss in Minneapolis on April 12, 2026.
